description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDirectoryDao class, which handles database operations related to employee directory searches, including retrieving employee lists and counts based on various filter parameters, and fetching employee data by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDao
classes.description: DAO class for retrieving employee directory information from the database, including employee lists, counts, and specific employee data by employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Returns a list of Employee entities matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches a single Employee entity by its employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object based on the provided filter parameters for retrieving employee data.
